name: Flat 2010s mark
region: the United States, worldwide on screens
summary: The gloss goes away. A simple symbol or a geometric sans word in 2–4 bright flat colours, with no gradient, no shadow and no bevel, drawn to work as a 24 px app icon first.

philosophy.core_thesis: On a screen honesty is flat colour: a mark is a set of clean shapes that read at icon size and scale with no loss.
design_principles: Fill each shape with one flat colour; no gradient, no shadow, no highlight.
Use 2–4 bright colours of the same lightness, side by side, or one colour on white.
Build the symbol from squares, circles and rounded rectangles on a 24 or 48 unit icon grid.
Round corners at 8–20% of the shape size, or use none, but use the same rule for every corner.
Set any letters in a geometric sans with a single-storey a and round dots, at one weight.
Draw a 24 px icon version first, then scale up; each part must be at least 2 px at 24 px.
anti_patterns: Gradients, except as a later trend
Thin strokes under 1/12 of the icon size

construction.grid: A square icon grid of 24 or 48 units with a 2-unit safe area; key shapes fit a circle, a square or a 4:3 rectangle in it.
construction.geometry: Circles, squares and rounded rectangles; angles at 0°, 45° and 90°.
construction.stroke_rule: Solid fills; where a stroke is used it is 1/12 of the icon size (2 units on a 24 grid).
construction.symmetry: A 2×2 or a radial arrangement is common; colour, not form, breaks the symmetry.
construction.detail_floor: No part under 1/12 of the icon height, so the icon reads at 24 px.

form.silhouette: A square at 1:1 for the icon; a wordmark beside it fits a 3:1 to 5:1 bar.
form.letterforms: A geometric sans, often custom, with circular bowls, a single-storey a or g and a weight near regular to medium.

colour.strategy: Primary-bright hues of near-equal lightness, each in its own shape, on white or on a dark ground.
colour.reversal_rule: Each shape becomes white on one dark ground; the gaps between the shapes keep the form.

reproduction.clear_space: A quarter of the symbol height on each side; on an icon, the safe area of the grid.
reproduction.media: Screens first: app icons, favicons, UI; then print and signs.

emotion.target_response: Friendly clarity: the viewer sees bright, simple shapes and feels a tool that is easy and open.

avoid_when: The brief asks for heritage, luxury or craft.
The brand must look different from software brands.

modifiers.how: Keep the shapes and the hues; add a top-lit gradient and a soft shadow under the mark.
Keep the grid; reduce to one colour and black, and replace rounded corners with square ones.

stroke_weight.note: A stroke is 1/12 of the icon size.
